bug_summary: defaultLogEntry.PanicがNoColor設定を無視し、常にANSIカラー付きでパニックスタックトレースを出力していた
pr_title: Drop the useColor parameter from pretty stack printing
pr_description: PrintPrettyStack and the underlying parse helper threaded a useColor flag through printPrettyStack purely to satisfy one call site. This collapses printPrettyStack/PrintPrettyStack into a single function and drops the parameter from prettyStack.parse, keeping the color behavior inline instead of passed around.
